system.description:
Tianqi Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Uncommon, Rot. 1 item slot (Small, Worn, RIS Passive). Attunement.

Prerequisites: Proficiency[2]

A protective paper glyph, with a sticky back, allowing you to slap it right on armor. The glyph shows a shield, with some details.

Rendproof (Passive): This item has 2 charges. When you take any levels of Rend to your armor, instead remove one charge from this item. You may refill a charge with 50gp at any market, but it does not charge on its own.

Rulebook p.68.
